name: bb-plugin-provider-retry-advanced
description: BB's provider retry plus automatic resume of turns that failed because the network or provider path was unreachable.
author: Sergey Petrov

bb.name: Provider retry advanced
bb.description: Retries provider overloads and subscription limits like the bundled Provider retry, and resumes turns that failed for lost connectivity once the provider answers again.

scripts.bundle: bb plugin build . && bun -e "const f = 'dist/server.js.map'; await Bun.write(f, (await Bun.file(f).text()).replaceAll(process.cwd() + '/', '../../'))"
